reading: This qualifies PERSISTENCE MACHINERY, not policy quality. Restoring the stored tail verbatim is the simplest possible maintenance rule; a real CAMR controller would recompute the suffix after each reveal. The result does not say the restored order is good, and it says nothing about energy, quality, or a 289-phase source day.
